title: Cost-of-Living Growth in the Commuted Value of Income Annuities Certain Installments
content:
Where an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract carries a cost-of-living rate, the commuted value of its remaining certain installments allows for the increases those installments would have received. How depends on the whole months left from the election to the certain period end date, measured against **36** months (the exact growth months).

**Fewer than 36 months left — installments raised year by year.** Each commuted installment is valued at the current installment increased by the cost-of-living rate once for each contract anniversary falling between now and its payment date: the commuted installments left in the current contract year (counting from the first commuted installment up to the next contract anniversary) are valued at the current installment; those of the next contract year at one increase (the current installment multiplied by one plus the cost-of-living rate); and all the rest at two increases (multiplied by one plus the rate, twice over). Each valued installment is then discounted as any commuted installment is.

**36 months or more left — growth allowed for in the discount.** The growth is allowed for by discounting the level current installment at the per-period rate reduced for the cost-of-living rate spread evenly over the payment periods of a year: the first commuted installment keeps its own discount, and each later commuted installment is carried one further period at a per-period discount equal to the ordinary per-period discount (one divided by one plus the per-period rate) multiplied by one plus the cost-of-living rate raised to the power of one divided by the installments per year.

**A contract with no cost-of-living rate** is outside both methods.

| Cost-of-living rate | Months left to the certain period end date | Method |
|---|---|---|
| Above 0% | Fewer than 36 | Installments raised year by year |
| Above 0% | 36 or more | Growth allowed for in the discount |
| 0% | Any | Neither method applies |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Monthly contract, cost-of-living rate 2%, current installment $1,500.00, 30 commuted installments, the first of them falling 3 months before the next contract anniversary: 3 installments valued at $1,500.00, 12 at $1,530.00, and the remaining 15 at $1,560.60. With 35 months left the year-by-year method applies; with 36 months left the discount method applies, the monthly growth being 1.02 raised to the power of one twelfth, about 1.00165.
